strokes.text: Manages one scene in an OBS scene collection.
The scene is tracked by the UUID that OBS assigns, so changing `name` renames the same scene in place and every placement inside it survives.
Destroying the resource removes the scene and the placements it contains.
Import a scene by its collection name and scene UUID, separated by a pipe character:
Write the matching configuration first: import reads the existing scene, it does not generate HCL.

glazes.name: Name of the scene as shown in OBS. Changing it renames the scene in place.
glazes.scene_uuid: UUID that OBS assigned to the scene. Other resources use it to say which scene they belong to.
